# <span id="aanchor252"></span> Annual Schedule Editor

Accessing this form requires **Application Process – FLOWCAL Options** privileges.

Use the Annual Schedule Editor to create schedules for an entire year. The Annual Schedule Editor allows you to:

- **Define specific batch dates for liquid meters** - Some batches run on a schedule that varies from month to month and year to year. For example: A batch may run every Monday, unless Monday is a holiday or is close to the start of the month or end of the month (Meter Editor \> Liquids tab \> Schedules sub-tab \> Monthly Schedule selection).
- **Print chart levels for scheduled chart routes for gas meters** - A schedule is used to specify the on and off dates for the charts, which is used when printing the Bar Code Labels report (Meter Editor \> Imports tab \> Chart Change Schedule selection).
- **Define schedules for weekly location rollups** - Location rollups can calculate weekly final form data for a location if the Calculate Weekly Totals option is enabled within System Configuration, and a weekly schedule is defined for a location. Weekly totals do not have to be seven days of data; this customized time span is defined using the Annual Schedule Editor (Location Editor \> Info menu \> Weekly Schedule selection).

<div class="procedure">

To create an annual schedule:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.

2.  Select **Annual Schedule Editor** within the **Application** group.

3.  Select a year.

    The year cannot be changed once you enter edit mode. Each year must be created and edited individually.

4.  Click the **New** button.

5.  Enter a schedule name.

6.  Double-click the days you want to include in the schedule.

    Selected days will display with a yellow highlight. To de-select a day, double-click it again.

7.  Click the **Save** button.
